evidence.statement: Across the frozen 1,000-token universe, the pairwise cross-genome boundary-role overlap statistic S_pair=97 versus independent-marginal null mean 58.898; Monte Carlo tail 9.9999e-06; LC-PRED-0019 outcome STRONGLY_SUPPORTED.
The result constrains whether MOP identity carries a reusable broad interface-context role across genomes; even when positive this remains C2 context recurrence, not C3 same-system identity.

unknowns: Whether recurrent boundary-role tokens belong to homologous systems.
Whether the same relationship transfers prospectively to held-out organisms.
